newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine August fiscal deficit $302 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentine August fiscal deficit $302 mln.

text.p: The Argentine government's fiscal deficit was $302 million in August, down from a deficit of $789 million in July and up from a $182 million shortfall in August 1995, the Economy Ministry said Thursday.
Spending in August was $1.48 billion, down from $1.86 billion in July but up slightly from $1.35 billion in August 1995.
Revenue, excluding capital such as privatizations, was $1.206 billion in August, up from $1.171 billion in July but down slightly from $1.215 billion in August 1995.
Revenue in the month from value-added tax rose to $499 million from $459 million in July.
